svg.text: Simply-Supported Beam · 3.2 m × 0.8 m · Neural SIMP + Adjoint Compliance
C30/37 concrete (E = 30 GPa, ν = 0.2) · B500B rebar (E = 200 GPa, bottom chord)
Classical compression fan visible. Dense top, steel bottom — textbook strut-and-tie.
Dense rows = load-carrying compression (top). Light rows above steel = removed dead weight.
The centroid line traces where structural mass concentrates — the compression resultant in a Strut-and-Tie model.
